platform: Linux ARM64 software renderer/OutputCallback PCM and actual native egui/AccessKit

first.reason: Production compilation refused twelve renderer calls to methods scoped only to the child surface module. Their actual production call sites now have minimal engine-only visibility; state fields remain private. This preliminary inventory had 806 inputs; the final frozen inventory also retains the unchanged embedded license-asset input.

second.reason: Production check passed. Test compilation refused an allocator-module import, an untyped generic callback sample vector and an unavailable vec2 shorthand. Fixtures now use the actual engine allocator counter, explicit f32 samples and the existing Vec2 constructor.

third.reason: Four core checks, both native workflows, the mapped FX button regression and all neighboring groups passed. Two full-output stereo assertions assumed a linear 2:1 amplitude ratio after the existing tanh limiter. Final assertions undo that known curve and retain the same tolerance; raw stereo histories already match exactly at six rates. No production sound correction is claimed for that fixture assumption. Final source also skips inactive dry units before timing/processor work and uses plain native control descriptions.

limits: Linux ARM64 software qualification: two independent live DJ FX units with three serial Echo/Reverb/Filter slots; separate stereo histories for both decks, one explicitly chosen stable sampler destination per unit and Master. Beat-clock or manual echo timing, applied duration, wet/bypass, independent source assignments and defined fader placement are native controls sharing the existing controller banks. Bypass/unassignment fades new wet injection over 2 ms and drains original tails without callback allocation; sampler unassignment retains its original bus, stale/replaced project targets retire safely, source/placement edits require off/settled histories. Dry units use a fast path. Native graph and legacy mixer cut/pause tails, actual OutputCallback, six-rate raw impulses, native egui/AccessKit and recorded wire-shaped mapping dispatch passed. Echo storage supports up to two seconds, with the applied cap shown; after two seconds of silence below 1e-7, inactive histories retire. These are transient live controls like the existing surface banks; no new project version, dependency or manufacturer address. No physical audio/MIDI device, capture, new OS GUI, mapped physical paddle or listening acceptance.

concurrentLibraryIntegration.reason: The other app work advanced the same remote tip before the FX push. Its DJ library changes were merged without overwriting either implementation; the only conflict was the generated source inventory. This forced-fresh combined build qualifies the integrated source on the ordinary test-thread stack.
